column1: # Dissociation-stress gene panel of eca-rsi (decision 0020). One row per gene considered.
# decision: panel = in the panel; excluded = considered and left out (reason says why); control = an anchor of the method.
# Candidates: the 25 genes of msp's old core (old_msp_core) and every gene in at least two of eight published
# dissociation-stress signatures (n_lists, lists: vdB = van den Brink 2017, the old osp list (old_osp_list); Adam = Adam 2017;
# OFl = O'Flanagan 2019; Den = Denisenko 2020; MB = Massoni-Badosa 2020; Mach = Machado 2017/2021; Marsh = Marsh 2022;
# VH = Van Hove 2019). class: HSP heat shock, IEG immediate early, TF, UPR, INF inflammatory, STR structural, HK housekeeping, OTH.
# Evidence: within each cell type of 18 human and 16 mouse dissociated-cell atlases (and 4 mouse nuclei atlases, where
# dissociation stress cannot arise), the Spearman correlation of the gene with the leave-one-out score of the seed core.
# human_r, mouse_r, nuclei_r = the median over types; *_coherent = the share of types with r > 0.1; *_detect = median
# share of cells detecting the gene; *_tau = cell-type specificity of its mean (it did not separate stress from identity genes).
# Rule: panel when r >= 0.15 in human and in mouse cells and coherent in >= 60% of types in both, minus identity
# and housekeeping genes; metallothioneins out by the owner's decision.
# mouse ... zebrafish: Ensembl Compara orthologs (symbol=Ensembl gene ID; - = no symbol). match: the names a dataset's
# genes are matched against, case-insensitively: human symbol, old symbols, human ID, orthologs' symbols and IDs.
